facts.text: Caroline mentioned a hand-painted bowl that was a gift from a friend for her 18th birthday ten years ago.

evidence.quote: I've got some other stuff with sentimental value, like my hand-painted bowl. A friend made it for my 18th birthday ten years ago.

facts.text: Caroline described the hand-painted bowl as having an awesome pattern and colors that remind her of art and self-expression.

evidence.quote: The pattern and colors are awesome-- it reminds me of art and self-expression.

facts.text: Melanie shared that she recently went camping in the mountains with her family and had a great time together.

evidence.quote: I just took my fam camping in the mountains last week - it was a really nice time together!

facts.text: Melanie described activities during the camping trip, including exploring nature, roasting marshmallows around a campfire, and going on a hike with her family.

evidence.quote: We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire and even went on a hike.
